crossRefs.note: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch…
The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.

They were arrogant, and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
I will stand at my watch, and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I…
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
translations.kjv: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:
translations.asv: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Jehovah:
